Sun & Moon series · LOT

Lost Thunder

Released November 2, 2018 · 240 cards

Expanded

Lost Thunder is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sun & Moon series, released in English on November 2, 2018. Its main set has 214 cards, plus 26 secret rares numbered beyond the set (240 in total). It includes 192 Pokémon, 47 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).
